title: Sodium lamp: warm amber pool inside a cold-blue field
note: A lamp is warm amber at a modest intensity and range; a cold-blue pool under a sodium lamp is an immediate rejection.
intent: A street lamp in a blue-hour exterior is warm amber (0xff8833-class, ~2000 K), intensity 3–8, distance 20–40, and the pool on the ground must show that warm tint — a cold-blue tint under a sodium lamp is an immediate rejection, and a diffuse floor-wide wash is not a pool. Give it a tight cone (≈ 15° spot with explicit falloff so the pool reads as an island) and a long soft shadow, and tint shadowed surfaces explicitly cold (#2a4a6f-class hemisphere) so the warm halo sits inside a cold field; mood words alone produce brownish-black shadows or flat washes. A bare fixture near the camera reads as an unlit silhouette, so the head itself is emissive. The integration notes must say which surfaces the warm light may reach and that the mist band renders after the lamp, below the pool’s edge.

check.js: objects('lamp').some(o => o.isLight) && objects('lamp').filter(o => o.isLight).every(l => l.color.r > 1.5 * l.color.b && l.intensity >= 3 && l.intensity <= 8 && l.distance >= 20 && l.distance <= 40)
check.note: Every light tagged lamp is warm amber (0xff8833-class: red > 1.5x blue), intensity 3-8, distance 20-40 - a cold-blue pool under a sodium lamp is an immediate rejection.

port: Place makeSodiumLamp() from the lighting/atmosphere facet, tag every light in the fixture "lamp" and the ground halo "lamp-pool", and state in integrationNotes which surfaces the warm light may reach and whether the cold tint overrides the warm fill. Verify all blue-hour items in a single default-camera screenshot: gradient sky, mist band, lit snow motes, cold shadow tint, warm halo pool.

evidence.note: sodium lamp point light warm amber 0xff8833, intensity 3–8, distance 20–40; cold-blue pool under a sodium lamp is an immediate rejection; light the pole so the fixture is not a bare silhouette
lighting briefs must give light type and cone (15° spot), falloff so the pool is an island, shadow tint as hex (#2a4a6f), fog colour separately
blue-hour checklist (d)/(e): cold-blue ambient on shadowed surfaces with a long soft lamp shadow; the sodium pool as a warm halo, not a diffuse wash
define the whole class in one pass: lamp colour temperature ~2000 K, ambient colour + intensity, verified from the default camera
